- [research/recovered/plugin_reports1/reports/recruit_sort_v4/core/STARTUP.md:39](../../research/recovered/plugin_reports1/reports/recruit_sort_v4/core/STARTUP.md?plain=1#L39-L39) — In Vahren ver0.67 DirectInput8Create has exactly one call site (VA 0x4BCE3B), reached from the startup loader thread 0x555AD0 via 0x4B78C0 -> 0x4B9E50 -> 0x4EE0C0 -> 0x4BCDD0. Code that already ran before that point (WinMain up to 0x555CD0 and the first part of the loader) cannot be hooked by this startup path. Plugin init therefore runs on the loader thread (main thread only in xp.txt synchronous mode); UI-thread installers must wait for that thread to exit (hakushin_loader_wait.h).
